team: The Gibbs That Keep On Giving

moves.text: Keep Malik Washington at WR over Antonio Williams, even though ESPN has Williams up 10.1 to 9.9
moves.why: Both lock at 1pm, so decide now. Over their last 5 games Washington has 32 targets, 24 catches and 7 carries; Williams has 26 targets and 16 catches, and has not topped 54 yards or scored in that span. Williams is a close second: McLaurin and Dyami Brown are on IR, Burks is inactive today, and he saw 7 targets last week.

moves.text: If DJ Moore or Dalton Kincaid is a surprise scratch Monday, check waivers for someone playing Sunday night or Monday
moves.why: Your whole usable bench locks at 1pm today (Young, White, Williams), and Evans is Out, Wilson is Out and Warren is on bye, so nobody on the roster can replace a Monday 8:15pm starter. Risk looks low: Moore (shoulder) has no designation and Kincaid (chest) practiced fully Friday. Depending on when the news breaks, only players in TB at CHI (Sunday 8:20pm) and BUF at MIN would still be unlocked.

moves.text: Week 10 prep: check waivers for a D/ST and RB cover, and check whether Tyson can stay in the IR slot
moves.why: The Bears and Jonah Coleman's Broncos are both on bye in Week 10, and the Vikings D/ST goes to Green Bay. Tyson (hamstring) came off real IR Saturday and is not on New Orleans' inactive list today, so ESPN may flag the IR slot and block adds until he moves. The bench is full, so that would take a drop. Warren returns from his bye next week, and Evans is questionable at best.

moves.text: Keep DJ Moore starting, Mike Evans benched
moves.why: Moore has no injury designation and is likely to play Monday at Minnesota; Evans is Out for Sunday vs the Raiders (Achilles).

moves.text: Keep Ollie Gordon II at flex over Rachaad White
Keep Brock Purdy starting over Bryce Young
Do not re-offer for Tee Higgins; the deal is closed
moves.why: The Nov 6 offer (Wilson + Warren for Higgins) was rejected or withdrawn before expiry and is no longer pending. Hold Wilson and Warren.
